# lemsa_nav_kit

PageNavigator over auto_route, AuthGuard / GuestGuard, deep-link table.

- Public barrel: lib/lemsa_nav_kit.dart
- AutoPageNavigator implements flutter_page_kit PageNavigator
- Guards take app-owned isSignedIn / AuthSession â€” no hardcoded providers
- Sign-out does not navigate; GuardReevaluate re-runs guards
- DeepLinkTable maps URI path patterns to typed routes
- Route args are @RoutePage constructor params
- dart run lemsa_nav_kit:gen is deferred; use build_runner + auto_route_generator
- FVM Flutter 3.35.7
